title: First visit or cleared browser storage yields the full set of defaults with no server-side profile
preconditions: 1. You have distinctive saved settings, then clear the browser's site data (or use a fresh profile).
steps: 1. Open the report and read every setting.
expected: 1. Date range = This Month; Product Type = "Parts & Service"; Invoice Status = "All Statuses"; Location = your active location; Show Unassigned = off; all seven metric columns visible; sort = the A→Z default.
2. Clearing browser storage fully returns the report to first-visit defaults — no server-side profile brings the old settings back.
